title: Short: Felicity Ace – sank with 4,000 luxury cars (map + Gemini objects)

lines.text: This ship sank with four thousand luxury cars on board.
In February twenty twenty-two, the Felicity Ace left Germany for the United States.
It was carrying Porsches, Bentleys and Lamborghinis worth about four hundred million dollars.
But near the Azores, a fire broke out.
All twenty-two crew members were rescued, but the ship kept burning for days.
Then, while it was being towed, it sank into the Atlantic.
Would you still ship your dream car across the ocean?
